title: Everyday Phrases — Handing Over the Night Shift

title_quote: Good morning, I am ten minutes early.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🌙 實用夜班交接必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Handing Over the Night Shift
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用夜班交接情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從提前十分鐘到辦公室、翻開交接本、三號床換了吊瓶、今晚有家屬要來、把走廊燈調暗、交代過敏名單、簽名字打卡下班，到最後說一聲早安，一共 800 句循環聽。不用背，睡前聽就會，重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多工作場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Handing Over the Night Shift phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Arrive ten minutes early, open the handover notebook, talk about the new drip, the family visiting tonight, the dim hallway lights, the allergy list, signing out — then say good morning. 800 lines on repeat, no memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I am ten minutes early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪ æm tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ˈɜrli./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are early, and that helps.
dialogue.zh: 你來得早，真是幫了大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I wake you at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ weɪk ju æt ði dɛsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I was still writing here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is a hot coffee for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə hɑt ˈkɔfi fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, you are too kind, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look tired from the long night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk ˈtaɪərd frʌm ðə lɔŋ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一個長夜下來你看起來很累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept ten minutes, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slɛpt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我只睡了十分鐘，就這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the ward quiet last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet, but I walked a lot.
dialogue.zh: 算安靜，但我走來走去很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else stayed here all night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only Sam, the ward helper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did any new patient come in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one old man at two.
dialogue.zh: 有，兩點進來一位老先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is he now, in which bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz hi naʊ, ɪn wɪtʃ bɛd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He rests in bed number eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His family stayed the whole night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His son sat there until now.
dialogue.zh: 他兒子坐在那裡到現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this chair free for a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs tʃɛr fri fər ə ˈmɪnɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這椅子我可以坐一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sit down and rest a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɪt daʊn ænd rɛst ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room feels cold this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The heater works, it is on low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhitər wɜrks, ɪt ɪz ɑn loʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn it up a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɜrn ɪt ʌp ə ˈlɪtəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, my fingers are stiff.
dialogue.zh: 請幫我轉大，我手指都硬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is raining outside, look there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it started around four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you wear that thin jacket all night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju wɛr ðæt θɪn ˈdʒækɪt ɔl naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你那件薄外套穿了一整夜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my hands are still so cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ hændz ɑr stɪl soʊ koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 對，我的手到現在還很冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want my spare warm socks?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt maɪ spɛr wɔrm sɑks?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them, my feet are fine now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm, maɪ fit ɑr faɪn naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coat is wet, where can I hang it?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ koʊt ɪz wɛt, wɛr kæn aɪ hæŋ ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我外套濕了，可以掛哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the hook behind the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my badge okay? It feels wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ bædʒ ˈoʊkeɪ? ɪt filz rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的識別證戴好了嗎？感覺怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks fine there, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks faɪn ðɛr, du nɑt ˈwɜri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I keep my bag today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ kip maɪ bæɡ təˈdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The low shelf under this desk.
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子下面的低架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did many people ring the bell last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈmɛni ˈpipəl rɪŋ ðə bɛl læst naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four times, all small things.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did they need each time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water, a blanket, and toilet help.
dialogue.zh: 水、一條毯子，還有上廁所。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody needed the doctor at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he slept at home, thank goodness.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, hi slɛpt æt hoʊm, θæŋk ˈgʊdnəs./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他在家睡覺，謝天謝地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many medicine rounds did you do?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛnɪ ˈmɛdəsən raʊndz dɪd ju du?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three rounds, from ten till four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did all the monitors work well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One beeped loudly near two.
dialogue.zh: 有一台接近兩點時大聲嗶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you do about that beep?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ju du əˈbaʊt ðæt bip?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I checked the wire, all good now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃɛkt ðə ˈwaɪər, ɔl gʊd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我檢查了線材，現在好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the supply room still locked at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə səˈplai rum stɪl lɑkt æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 物品室夜間還是鎖著的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the key hangs by that door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ki hæŋz baɪ ðæt dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the old printer still eat paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði oʊld ˈprɪntər stɪl it ˈpeɪpər?/
dialogue.zh: 那台舊印表機還會咬紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice last night, both times I fixed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs læst naɪt, boʊθ taɪmz aɪ fɪkst ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You must be ready to go home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju məst bi ˈrɛdi tu goʊ hoʊm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, I sign the book first.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，我得先簽交接本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will you get back this morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪl ju gɛt bæk ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus at seven on Hill Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs æt ˈsɛvən ɑn hɪl strit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the seven bus usually full?
dialogue.zh: 七點的公車通常很滿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is slow and empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What will you eat when you get home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt wɪl ju it wɛn ju gɛt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice and eggs, then a long sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs ænd ɛgz, ðɛn ə lɔŋ slip./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you sleep the whole afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will wake up at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ wɪl weɪk ʌp æt faɪv./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you turn your phone off to sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju tɜrn jɔr foʊn ɔf tu slip?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set it to silent, then forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ɪt tu ˈsaɪlənt, ðɛn fərˈgɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you worked this ward?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju wɜrkt ðɪs wɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 你在這病房工作了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six years, since my first day shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks jɪrz, sɪns maɪ fɜrst deɪ ʃɪft./
dialogue.zh: 六年了，從我第一次白班算起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you like night work at first?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju laɪk naɪt wɜrk æt fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hated it, now I love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈheɪtɪd ɪt, naʊ aɪ lʌv ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And how long have you been here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju bɪn hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only three weeks, so I ask a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli θri wiːks, soʊ aɪ ɑsk ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 才三週，所以我常常發問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fine, we all start new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn, wi ɔl stɑrt nu./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我們都是從頭開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that helps me relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the extra blanket, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second shelf, left, under the gloves.
dialogue.zh: 第二層架子，左邊，手套下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the clean paper for the cart?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə klin ˈpeɪpər fər ðə kɑrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue box next to the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu bɑks ˈnɛkst tu ðə wɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the phone ring in this office?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə foʊn rɪŋ ɪn ðɪs ˈɔfɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 電話會在這個辦公室響嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two lines, both on that wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tu laɪnz, boʊθ ɑn ðæt wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 會，兩條線，都在那面牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which number do I call for help?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈnʌmbər du aɪ kɔl fər hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 要找人幫忙時我撥哪個號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, it wakes the guard downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 九號，會叫醒樓下的保全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he nice, the night guard?
dialogue.zh: 他人好不好，那個夜班保全？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he brings tea around three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any patient awake right now?
dialogue.zh: 現在有哪一位病人醒著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed five reads, she likes mornings.
dialogue.zh: 五號床在看書，她喜歡早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I check her before the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tʃɛk hɜr bɪˈfɔr ðə lɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 我先去看她再對名單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, she is calm, stay with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ʃi ɪz kɑm, steɪ wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 不用，她很平穩，先跟我這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, then let us start the report.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðɛn lɛt ʌs stɑrt ðə rɪˈpɔrt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, open the book to page nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈoʊpən ðə bʊk tu peɪdʒ naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the new book with blue lines?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə nu bʊk wɪθ blu laɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 這是新的藍格線那本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the old one was too full.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ði oʊld wʌn wəz tu fʊl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you write on every patient here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju raɪt ɑn ˈɛvəri ˈpeɪʃənt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 每位病人都要在這本上寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the ones with changes tonight.
dialogue.zh: 只有這夜有變化的那幾位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many patients are on this ward?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛnɪ ˈpeɪʃənts ɑr ɑn ðɪs wɔrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve beds, ten filled right now.
dialogue.zh: 十二張床，現在住了十位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the last two beds empty tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə læst tu bɛdz ˈɛmpli təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 最後兩張床今晚空著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we expect one after eight.
dialogue.zh: 不會，八點後預計來一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let me read your short lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt mi rid jʊr ʃɔrt laɪnz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, I will wait here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm, aɪ wɪl weɪt hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last small thing before we read.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst smɔl θɪŋ bɪˈfɔr wi rid./
dialogue.zh: 讀之前還有最後一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask me anything you need.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page nine, is this tonight's page?
dialogue.zh: 第九頁，這是今晚那頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the notes are all here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your handwriting is small but clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I write small, the page is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ raɪt smɔl, ðə peɪdʒ ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我故意寫小，這一頁都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does this little mark mean?
dialogue.zh: 這個小符號是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means she sleeps with a light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz ʃi slips wɪð ə laɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me start at bed number one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi stɑrt æt bɛd ˈnʌmbər wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she is the early waker.
dialogue.zh: 好，她是最早醒的那一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady with the white hair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you know her already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I watch with her?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her hearing is low, speak slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I call her by her first name?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kɔl hɜr baɪ hɜr fɜrst neɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以直接叫她的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She likes the name Auntie May.
dialogue.zh: 她喜歡人家喊她梅阿姨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she eat last night's dinner?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a plate, and some warm soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə pleɪt, ænd sʌm wɔrm sup./
dialogue.zh: 吃了一半，還喝了些熱湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is her water cup by the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hɜr ˈwɔtər kʌp baɪ ðə bɛd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fill it before nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed two says bad sleep here.
dialogue.zh: 二號床這行寫說睡得不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, he wakes near one again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he walk to the hall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only with two hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who helps him in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The day aide comes at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blood pressure here looks good.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的血壓看起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I took it twice, at one and four.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk ɪt twaɪs, æt wʌn ænd fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我量了兩次，一點和四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which arm do I use for him?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ɑrm du aɪ juz fər hɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left one, the right is sore.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft wʌn, ðə raɪt ɪz sɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His temperature was high last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came down around twelve.
dialogue.zh: 大約十二點就退下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no more fever, that is great.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ mɔr ˈfivər, ðæt ɪz greɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check it once more near noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who needs help to the toilet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed four, his legs are weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he use the tall frame?
dialogue.zh: 他用那個高的助行架嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the silver one by his bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈsɪlvər wʌn baɪ hɪz bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone on the wheelchair list?
dialogue.zh: 有哪位病人要用輪椅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two: bed four and sweet bed five.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu, bɛd fɔr ænd swit bɛd faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 兩位：四號床，還有和善的五號床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she push it to the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ʃi puʃ ɪt tu ðə ˈwɪndoʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she loves the sun and birds.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃi lʌvz ðə sʌn ænd bɜrdz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who eats without help this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most, except the new old man.
dialogue.zh: 大部分，除了新來的老先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is his breakfast at eight then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soft food only, no hard bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɔft fud ˈoʊnli, noʊ hɑrd brɛd./
dialogue.zh: 對，只吃軟的，不要硬麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he have a little tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small cup, and no sugar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any patient here with no food?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed ten eats nothing before noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the blood test this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the van takes him at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə væn teɪks hɪm æt naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote that on my hand here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rote ðæt ɑn maɪ hænd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我把這件事寫在我手上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better write it in the last column.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər raɪt ɪt ɪn ðə læst ˈkɑləm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this book show each medicine time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs bʊk ʃoʊ itʃ ˈmɛdəsən taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這本子會記每次給藥的時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three short lines for each one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, θri ʃɔrt laɪnz fər itʃ wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who falls out of bed easily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed six, keep the rails up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the rails clean and dry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wipe them with a dry cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, waɪp ðɛm wɪð ə draɪ klɔθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next line says loud snoring.
dialogue.zh: 下一行寫說打呼很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is bed nine, he sleeps deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz bɛd naɪn, hi slips dip./
dialogue.zh: 那是九號床，他睡得很沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close his door at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kloz hɪz dɔr æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我晚上要把他的門關上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he sleeps with it wide open.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, hi slips wɪð ɪt waɪd ˈopoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 不用，他睡覺時門都大開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who has the longest note here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will see it on page ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl si ɪt ɑn peɪdʒ tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 你翻到第十頁就會看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper is thin, I pressed hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpər ɪz θɪn, aɪ prist hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 紙很薄，我剛才按太重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the lines show on the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðə laɪnz ʃoʊ ɑn ðə bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a pen tied to this book?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə pɛn taɪd tu ðɪs bʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 這本子有綁著一支筆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on a string, never take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɑn ə strɪŋ, ˈnɛvər teɪk ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign here, at the bottom?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ saɪn hɪr, æt ðə ˈbɑtəm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your name and the time, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, jʊr neɪm ænd ðə taɪm, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 對，簽你的名字還有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I write the full date too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ raɪt ðə fʊl deɪt tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the month and the day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does this book stay all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðɪs bʊk steɪ ɔl deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On this desk, not in the ward.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðɪs dɛsk, nɑt ɪn ðə wɔrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can a family member read it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is for staff, not guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt ɪz fər stæf, nɑt gɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 不行，只給工作的同仁看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I need more room to write?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ nid mɔr rum tu raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我需要更多空格寫呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the extra sheets in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði ˈɛkstrə ʃits ɪn ðə drɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we keep old books here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they go upstairs after one week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðeɪ gʌp ˈstɛrz ˈæftər wʌn wik./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you finish last night's page?
dialogue.zh: 昨晚那一頁你寫完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one line about bed three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then tell me that line first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but look at the whole ward first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, bʌt lʊk æt ðə hoʊl wɔrd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，不過先把整區看一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, this column is the night calls?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðɪs ˈkɑləm ɪz ðə naɪt kɔlz?/
dialogue.zh: 好，這一欄是夜裡接的電話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two calls, both about one man.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tu kɔlz, boʊθ əˈbaʊt wʌn mæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which number shows the family lines?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last one, on the right side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst wʌn, ɑn ðə raɪt saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her son's number is here, right?
dialogue.zh: 她兒子的號碼在這裡，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, call him only after ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you write the time on each line?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju raɪt ðə taɪm ɑn itʃ laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 每一行你都寫了時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten forty, one, and four.
dialogue.zh: 有，十點四十、一點和四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This page is nearly full already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn to ten when you are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn tu tɛn wɛn ju ɑr dʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last column, what is here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Special notes, like lights and visits.
dialogue.zh: 特別交代，像是燈和探訪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this book holds the whole night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs bʊk hoʊldz ðə hoʊl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 所以這本子裝了一整個夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And yours will hold the next.
dialogue.zh: 下一段夜就交給你的筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the line about bed three.
dialogue.zh: 現在來說三號床那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his drip changed in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪz drɪp tʃeɪndʒd ɪn ðə dɑrk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new drip? What happened at two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu drɪp? wʌt həˈpɛnd æt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 新吊瓶？兩點時發生了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old bag ran almost empty.
dialogue.zh: 舊的那個袋子快滴完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you change it yourself?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I changed it, Sam brought the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃeɪndʒd ɪt, sæm brɔt ðə bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the new bag the right size?
dialogue.phonetic: /wəz ðə nu bæɡ ðə raɪt saɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the same kind, one full liter.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə seɪm kaɪnd, wʌn fʊl ˈlitər./
dialogue.zh: 對，同樣那一種，整整一公升。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the new needle?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju pʊt ðə nu ˈnidəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His left hand, the other one swelled.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz lɛft hænd, ði ˈʌðər wʌn swɛld./
dialogue.zh: 他的左手，另一邊腫起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the skin around it red?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little pink, I marked the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl pɪŋk, aɪ ˈmɑrkt ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 有一點粉紅，我用筆圈了範圍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, so I can see the change.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd, soʊ aɪ kæn si ðə tʃeɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣我看得出差變化。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it down at ten and two.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt daʊn æt tɛn ænd tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast is the drip now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, about twenty drops a minute.
dialogue.zh: 很慢，一分鐘大約二十滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the doctor say that speed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on the phone, write it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɑn ðə foʊn, raɪt ɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 有，在電話裡說的，寫在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tube free of bubbles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I checked twice, no air inside.
dialogue.zh: 我查了兩次，裡面沒有空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tape tight on his skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə teɪp taɪt ɑn hɪz skɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It felt loose, so I added more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɛlt lus, soʊ aɪ ˈædəd mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得鬆了，所以又補一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does his arm hurt when it runs?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hɪz ɑrm hɜrt wɛn ɪt rʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 藥水流動時他手臂會痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says it burns, so slow it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ɪt bɜrnz, soʊ sloʊ ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 他說會灼痛，所以要調慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he pull the tube out again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hi pʊl ðə tjub aʊt əˈgɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 他會不會又把管子拔下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He tried at four, watch his sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi traɪd æt fɔr, wɑtʃ hɪz slip./
dialogue.zh: 四點他試過，注意他睡著時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you put on the soft gloves?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju pʊt ɑn ðə sɔft glʊvz?/
dialogue.zh: 你有幫他戴上軟手套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are in the drawer there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ ɑr ɪn ðə drɔr ðɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the stand on the left side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə stænd ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the wheels are locked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the bag stay high up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, higher than his heart level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the bag runs empty again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə bæɡ rʌnz ˈɛmpli əˈgɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not pull it, call the ward phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt pʊl ɪt, kɔl ðə wɔrd foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 別亂拔，先打護理站的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the red line goes up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə rɛd laɪn goʊz ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close the wheel and call the doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloz ðə wil ænd kɔl ðə ˈdɑktər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is in that bag today?
dialogue.zh: 那個袋子裡裝的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water and sugar, plus one medicine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that medicine make him sleepy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, so do not move him far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt, soʊ du nɑt muv hɪm fɑr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he eat with the drip on?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd hi it wɪð ðə drɪp ɑn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, toast and soup, no mess.
dialogue.zh: 有，吐司加湯，弄得很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he shower with the tube?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, wipe him, keep it dry.
dialogue.zh: 不行，擦身就好，保持乾爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you write the change time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two five, right in the book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a new tube date on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə nu tjub deɪt ɑn ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 上面有標管線的日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, change the whole line Friday.
dialogue.zh: 有，星期五要換整條管線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is his blood sugar today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little high, the doctor knows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I check it before lunch?
dialogue.zh: 我午餐前要再測一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use the other hand for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, juz ði ˈʌðər hænd fər ðæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does he like to drink?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weak tea, warm, in a small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wik ti, wɔrm, ɪn ə smɔl kʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he awake now in bed three?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hi əˈweɪk naʊ ɪn bɛd θri?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he is sitting up a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hi ɪz ˈsɪtɪŋ ʌp ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I go say hello to him?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ goʊ seɪ hɛˈloʊ tu hɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我能過去跟他問個好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, he loves a friendly voice.
dialogue.zh: 當然，他愛聽人陪他講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he ask about the drip much?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi ɑsk əˈbaʊt ðə drɪp mʌtʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice an hour, answer short.
dialogue.zh: 一小時問兩次，答案要簡短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I say when he asks?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ seɪ wɛn hi ɑsks?/
dialogue.zh: 他問的時候我該怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him it is slow and safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ɪt ɪz sloʊ ænd seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 就跟他說很慢也很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he sleep at all after two?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd hi slip ət ɔl ˈæftər tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours, then the bell rang.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that for the cold hand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and one new pillow too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soft pillow is in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔft ˈpɪloʊ ɪz ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you learned that fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about his morning pills?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them after the tea, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they the small white ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the yellow round ones today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will read the label twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, names are close on this cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, neɪmz ɑr kloʊz ɑn ðɪs kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 好，車上的藥名很容易混。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does his wife know about the change?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hɪz waɪf noʊ əˈbaʊt ðə tʃeɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 他太太知道換了吊瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, she comes at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell her when she arrives?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛl hɜr wɛn ʃi əˈraɪvz?/
dialogue.zh: 她到的時候我該說一聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show her the bag, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any other patient on a drip now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈʌðər ˈpeɪʃənt ɑn ə drɪp naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在還有別人掛吊瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more, bed two, only water.
dialogue.zh: 還有一位，二號床，只輸水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that one easy to watch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he sleeps through everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the drip stand fall last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə drɪp stænd fɔl læst naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but the cord was under a wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, bʌt ðə kɔrd wəz ˈʌndər ə wil./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但管線纏到輪子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep the cord clear today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ðə kɔrd klɪr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天我會把管線理乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that bit scared me.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，那一下有點嚇到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the light above his bed on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə laɪt əˈbʌv hɪz bɛd ɑn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off, but the night lamp is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf, bʌt ðə naɪt læmp ɪz ɑn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button stops the flow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small wheel, turn it right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I practice on an empty line?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈpræktɪs ɑn ən ˈɛmpli laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我能在空管線上練習嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the spare set is in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə spɛr sɛt ɪz ɪn ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 可以，備用的一套在盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me again before you go, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi əˈgɛn bɪˈfɔr ju goʊ, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 拜託你走前再示範一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, stand close to the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, stænd kloʊs tu ðə bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you record the drop count?
dialogue.zh: 你有記錄每次的滴數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every hour, from three to six.
dialogue.zh: 每小時都記，從三點到六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is six the same as my first check?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz sɪks ðə seɪm æz maɪ fɜrst tʃɛk?/
dialogue.zh: 六點那次和我第一次查一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write yours beside mine.
dialogue.zh: 一樣，把你的字寫在我旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more small thing about bed three.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr smɔl θɪŋ əˈbaʊt bɛd θri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his family comes tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the ward doctor see him since then?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə wɔrd ˈdɑktər si hɪm sɪns ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 後來病房醫生看過他了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He came at five, and nodded.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His son is coming tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, after seven, he said so.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you tell the patient already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he smiled like a boy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long since they last met?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years, maybe a little more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where will the son wait tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the small room by the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə smɔl rum baɪ ðə geɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就在大門旁那間小休息室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that room warm enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a lamp, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he press the bell or knock?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hi prɛs ðə bɛl ɔr nɑk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bell, we keep the door closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛl, wi kip ðə dɔr kloʊzd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I let him straight in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but say his name to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt seɪ hɪz neɪm tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但先跟我說他的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His name is David, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, he will say the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have an extra chair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two in the closet, folded flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is one chair enough for the night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz wʌn tʃɛr ɪˈnʌf fər ðə naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 一張椅子夠他過一夜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can sleep in the tall chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn slip ɪn ðə tɔl tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 他可以在那張高椅上睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that chair lie back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, and it has wheels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a thin blanket in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə θɪn ˈblæŋkɪt ɪn ðə drɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, give it to him at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, gɪv ɪt tu hɪm æt naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he need a pillow, too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him first, do not guess.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are visitors allowed to stay all night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ˈvɪzɪtərz əˈlaʊd tu steɪ ɔl naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 訪客可以整夜留下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for this one case, sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why only him, what is the rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ˈoʊnli hɪm, wʌt ɪz ðə rul?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼只有他可以，規矩是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The doctor wrote it on the page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑktər roʊt ɪt ɑn ðə peɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he bring food for his dad?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi brɪŋ fud fər hɪz dæd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only fruit, no home cooking.
dialogue.zh: 只能帶水果，不能自家煮的菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No cake? He asked about cake.
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕也不行嗎？他問過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No sugar for him, you know.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he bring a book or cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi brɪŋ ə bʊk ɔr kɑrdz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is a nice gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about flowers from the shop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No flowers here, mind the list.
dialogue.zh: 這裡不准送花，想想那份名單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pollen list for bed five?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she sneezes all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I say this rule to the son?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ seɪ ðɪs rul tu ðə sʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 這規矩我要告訴他兒子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it once, with a soft face.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt wʌns, wɪð ə sɔft feɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the son smoke at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He tried to quit last year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then he must go down to the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi məst goʊ daʊn tu ðə geɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那他想抽就得走到大門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, outside, not in the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to write his number?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu raɪt hɪz ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 他的電話我要抄下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is already in the last column.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn ðə læst ˈkɑləm./
dialogue.zh: 已經寫在最後那一欄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he work far from here?
dialogue.zh: 他工作在很遠的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two towns away, one hour drive.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he stay until morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He plans to, if roads are clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi plænz tu, ɪf roʊdz ɑr klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 他計畫這樣，只要路好走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is bed three ready for a visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz bɛd θri ˈrɛdi fər ə ˈvɪzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 三號床準備好見客了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, his shirt is still damp.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，他的襯衫還濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean shirts are on the cart.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, help him put one on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave the drip during that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liv ðə drɪp ˈdʊrɪŋ ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 換衣服時吊瓶可以不管嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one aide holds the stand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he want to sit up with his son?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi wɑnt tu sɪt ʌp wɪð hɪz sʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asked for the chair twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the old man nervous today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asked me twice already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else is coming this evening?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody, only this one son.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about bed one, any calls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her daughter calls at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take that phone here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep talks short, two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any family coming in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed six's wife comes at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she the one with the walker?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ʃi ðə wʌn wɪð ðə ˈwɔkər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and she brings his glasses.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should a guest sit by a bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd ə gɛst sɪt baɪ ə bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 來探病的人該坐床邊哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The low chair, never on the cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə loʊ tʃɛr, ˈnɛvər ɑn ðə kɑrt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if two families come at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf tu ˈfæməliz kʌm æt wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 如果兩組家屬同時來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send one to the hall, kindly.
dialogue.zh: 客氣地請一位先去走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have a rule about kids?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv ə rul əˈbaʊt kɪdz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No children under twelve in here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡不收十二歲以下的小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the son have kids?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small girl, she stayed home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she draw a picture for grandpa?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ʃi drɔ ə ˈpɪktʃər fər ˈgrændˌpɑ?/
dialogue.zh: 她能為爺爺畫一張圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tape it above the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the family bring his papers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The son has one blue folder.
dialogue.zh: 兒子帶著一個藍色資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I keep those papers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the drawer with a lock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I copy his old list here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈkɑpi hɪz oʊld lɪst hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 舊名單我能在這裡影印嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the machine eats no paper now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə məˈʃin its noʊ ˈpeɪpər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，那機器現在不咬紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a small miracle, truly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not tell the others I said that.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tɛl ði ˈʌðərz aɪ sɛd ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 別跟別人說我講過這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the son asks hard things?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə sʌn ɑsks hɑrd θɪŋz?/
dialogue.zh: 如果他兒子問很難的問題呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say you will ask the doctor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I give him a name, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ gɪv hɪm ə neɪm, tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我也要把醫生的名字給他嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Doctor Hsu comes at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the family know about the drip?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈfæməli noʊ əˈbaʊt ðə drɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 家屬知道換吊瓶的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but tell them today.
dialogue.zh: 還不知道，今天告訴他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Families worry more than we think.
dialogue.zh: 家屬比我們想的更擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, worry is hard to hold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I forget, one more note.
dialogue.zh: 趁我還沒忘，再交代一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lights? Yes, walk with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us walk the hall while we talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs wɔk ðə hɔl waɪl wi tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 我們邊走邊說走廊好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, my shoes are ready.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我的鞋子已穿好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These hall lights are still at full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz hɔl laɪts ɑr stɪl æt fʊl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I left them bright all night.
dialogue.zh: 是我整夜都把他們開到最亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you leave them on for safety?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju liv ðɛm ɑn fər ˈseɪfti?/
dialogue.zh: 你是為了安全才開著的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a man fell here in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə mæn fɛl hɪr ɪn dʒun./
dialogue.zh: 是的，六月有人在這裡跌倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he better now, that fell man?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hi ˈbɛtər naʊ, ðæt fɛl mæn?/
dialogue.zh: 那個跌倒的人現在好點了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He went home last week, walking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we can turn the lights down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn tɜrn ðə laɪts daʊn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在可以把燈調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, one switch at a time.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，一次轉一個開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the first switch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the water cooler, the round one.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə ˈwɔtər ˈkulər, ðə raʊnd wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See how the whole hall softens now?
dialogue.phonetic: /si haʊ ðə hoʊl hɔl ˈsɔfənz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你看，整條走廊都柔和了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much kinder to sleeping eyes.
dialogue.zh: 對睡著的眼睛溫柔多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we keep one light strong somewhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi kip wʌn laɪt strɔŋ ˈswɛrhwɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always the one above the nurses' desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz ði wʌn əˈbʌv ðə ˈnɜrsəz dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 一直都要留護理站上面那盞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the bathroom light stays on?
dialogue.zh: 洗手間的燈就讓它亮著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, an old man woke twice there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ən oʊld mæn woʊk twaɪs ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 對，有位老先生在那裡醒了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I check the last door myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tʃɛk ðə læst dɔr maɪˈsɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一道門我要自己檢查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the latch there sticks sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 要，那裡的門閂有時候卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun will wake most of them soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn wɪl weɪk moʊst ʌv ðɛm sun./
dialogue.zh: 太陽很快就會把大部分人叫醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close half the blinds, just a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloz hæf ðə blaɪndz, dʒʌst ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 窗簾拉一半就好，一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not all the way down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They like to know it is morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ laɪk tu noʊ ɪt ɪz ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 他們喜歡知道已經是早上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed two wakes at the smallest sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛd tu weɪks æt ðə ˈsmɔləst saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 二號床聽到最小的聲音就醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So carry nothing with the cart yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈkæri ˈnʌθɪŋ wɪð ðə kɑrt jɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes are loud, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz ɑr laʊd, ˈsɔri əˈbaʊt ðæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the soft ones under the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə sɔft wʌnz ˈʌndər ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 桌子下有軟底的可以換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those slippers clean inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, washed yesterday, dry now.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨，昨天洗過，已經乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will speak in a low voice here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl spik ɪn ə loʊ vɔɪs hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡我們要小聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whisper now, the doors are thin.
dialogue.zh: 現在就用耳語吧，門很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the air too warm for sleeping?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði ɛr tu wɔrm fər ˈslipɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 空氣對睡覺來說太熱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the fan to the slow mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə fæn tu ðə sloʊ mɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 把風扇轉到最慢那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan hums a soft night tune.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn hʌmz ə sɔft naɪt tun./
dialogue.zh: 風扇哼著夜裡柔軟的調子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helped the crying man at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛlpt ðə ˈkraɪɪŋ mæn æt θri./
dialogue.zh: 它幫了三點那個哭的病人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was he alone and scared?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, dark feels big at three.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，凌晨三點的夜顯得很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will visit the beds before eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈvɪzɪt ðə bɛdz bɪˈfɔr eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我會在八點前先巡一次床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then start at bed number one.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd, ðɛn stɑrt æt bɛd ˈnʌmbər wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 很好，那就從一號床開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they need the lights dim again at ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ nid ðə laɪts dɪm əˈgɛn æt tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 十點時要把燈再調暗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the night switch does that itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə naɪt swɪtʃ dʌz ðæt ɪtˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 不用，晚上的開關會自動調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who made that clever thing?
dialogue.zh: 是誰設計了那個聰明東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An electrician from the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the dim wheel, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把那個調光轉輪給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, turn it left for less light.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, tɜrn ɪt lɛft fər lɛs laɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a mark I can follow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə mɑrk aɪ kæn ˈfɑloʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 上面有我可以照著的記號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the dot means night level.
dialogue.zh: 有，那個圓點代表夜間亮度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the hall looks soft and grey.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə hɔl lʊks sɔft ænd greɪ./
dialogue.zh: 現在走廊看起來柔軟又灰灰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better for tired eyes, right?
dialogue.zh: 對累的眼睛比較好，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody has complained about the dark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One lady asked for a small lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈleɪdi ɑskt fər ə smɔl læmp./
dialogue.zh: 有一位太太要一盞小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she get one from the drawer?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi gɛt wʌn frʌm ðə drɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 她從抽屜裡拿到一盞了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it glows orange, she likes it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt gloʊz ˈɔrɪndʒ, ʃi laɪks ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any bulb burnt out this week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, both in the far hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who do I call about a dead bulb?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu du aɪ kɔl əˈbaʊt ə dɛd bʌlb?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on the slip for maintenance.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn ðə slɪp fər ˈmeɪntənəns./
dialogue.zh: 寫在給維修那一組的單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that slip still on the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt slɪp stɪl ɑn ðə wɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 那張單子還掛在牆上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with a pencil on a string.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɪð ə ˈpɛnsəl ɑn ə strɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 對，旁邊還有一枝拴著的鉛筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The carpet here is worn thin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful with wet feet, it slips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will dry my shoes first, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl draɪ maɪ ʃuz fɜrst, ðɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old habit, you learn fast.
dialogue.zh: 這是老習慣，你學得真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which door leads to the back stair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ dɔr lidz tu ðə bæk stɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一道門通往後面的樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one, near the supply room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd wʌn, nɪr ðə səˈplai rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that stair dark at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has one small green lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A green lamp, that is kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It never goes out, never.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If power fails, what then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two flashlights hang by the door.
dialogue.zh: 手電筒有兩支掛在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you need one last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only once this winter.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，整個冬天只用過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights near bed three stay up a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts nɪr bɛd θri steɪ ʌp ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 三號床那附近的燈留亮一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the drip, so I can see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ðə drɪp, soʊ aɪ kæn si ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是為了吊瓶，讓我看得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the last hall before you go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ðə læst hɔl bɪˈfɔr ju goʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你走之前能帶我看完最後那段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, come, and walk slow here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The end of the hall looks like a cave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛnd ʌv ðə hɔl lʊks laɪk ə keɪv./
dialogue.zh: 走廊盡頭看起來像個山洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our quiet cave, my favorite spot.
dialogue.zh: 我們安靜的山洞，我最愛那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you ever sit there alone?
dialogue.zh: 你偶爾獨自坐在那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At five, with one warm cup.
dialogue.zh: 五點的時候，端一杯熱飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like the best part.
dialogue.zh: 那聽起來是最好的時刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, before the sun is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz, bɪˈfɔr ðə sʌn ɪz laʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sun loud, you are a poet.
dialogue.zh: 太陽會吵，你簡直是詩人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a tired night worker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I write this down, one thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr aɪ raɪt ðɪs daʊn, wʌn θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我寫下來之前，還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the allergy page? I forgot.
dialogue.zh: 要，過敏那一頁？我差點忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us sit and read that list now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs sɪt ænd rid ðæt lɪst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們坐下來把那張名單讀一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, it is the page I fear most.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz, ɪt ɪz ðə peɪdʒ aɪ fɪr moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 拜託，那是我最怕的一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fear is fair when pills are near.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪr ɪz fɛr wɛn pɪlz ɑr nɪr./
dialogue.zh: 藥就在旁邊，會怕很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really do learn fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red paper, is that the one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd ˈpeɪpər, ɪz ðæt ði wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 那張紅色的紙，是那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three names in black ink.
dialogue.zh: 對，黑墨水寫著三個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three names, and that is all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three here, plus two new today.
dialogue.zh: 這裡三個，今天還多了兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start with the first name.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt wɪð ðə fɜrst neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我們從第一個名字開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed one, auntie, allergic to nuts.
dialogue.zh: 一號床的阿姨，對堅果過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who stands at the top of this list?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu stændz æt ðə tɑp ʌv ðɪs lɪst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new man, bed number eight.
dialogue.zh: 那位新來的老先生，八號床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nuts, what kind of nuts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peanuts, and almond milk too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she eating anything with nuts?
dialogue.zh: 她吃的東西裡會有堅果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we check every tray twice.
dialogue.zh: 不會，每個餐盤我們都查兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else looks at the tray?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen, then me, then you.
dialogue.zh: 廚房，然後是我，接著換你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a visitor brings cookies?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the box, then ask me.
dialogue.zh: 先讀外盒的標示，再問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she ever react badly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once at home, many years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happened on her skin?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red spots, and one big lip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is why the list is red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ ðə lɪst ɪz rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 所以這張名單才用紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Color is a fast warning, yes.
dialogue.zh: 顏色是最快的提醒，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second name is the new man.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈsɛkənd neɪm ɪz ðə nu mæn./
dialogue.zh: 第二個名字是那位新來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shellfish, so no shrimp soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is soup a problem here often?
dialogue.zh: 湯在這裡常常是問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Family soup tastes strong here.
dialogue.zh: 家屬送來的湯味道都很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he eat fish at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish is fine, only shrimp is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ ɪz faɪn, ˈoʊnli ʃrimp ɪz bæd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he know that before coming?
dialogue.zh: 他住進來之前知道這件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, his daughter told us here.
dialogue.zh: 不知道，是我們這裡他女兒說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we write what family says?
dialogue.zh: 所以家屬說什麼我們就寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it, then ask the doctor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the third name here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed two, no penicillin for him.
dialogue.zh: 二號床，他不能用青黴素。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a shot or a pill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə ʃɑt ɔr ə pɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, so both are kept away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the pill with the red cap?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə pɪl wɪð ðə rɛd kæp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it comes in a white bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt kʌmz ɪn ə waɪt ˈbɑtəl./
dialogue.zh: 不是，它裝在白色的瓶子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if he gets it?
dialogue.zh: 如果他用到那種藥會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His throat closes, very fast.
dialogue.zh: 他喉嚨會閉起來，非常快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the worst one here.
dialogue.zh: 那是這裡最嚴重的一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So read the label, every time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The two new names, are they hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði tu nu neɪmz, ɑr ðeɪ hɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 新加的兩個名字，麻煩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is milk, one is a cream.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪz mɪlk, wʌn ɪz ə krim./
dialogue.zh: 一個是牛奶，一個是藥膏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk in tea, is that bad?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No milk at all in his cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɪlk ət ɔl ɪn hɪz kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 他的杯子一點牛奶都不能有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who put milk in it last time?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu pʊt mɪlk ɪn ɪt læst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 上次是誰把牛奶加進去的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A kind helper, by mistake.
dialogue.zh: 是好心的助理，不小心加的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is how mistakes happen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kindness needs a check, too.
dialogue.zh: 好心也得配上核對才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we mark these patients?
dialogue.zh: 我們怎麼標記這些病人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A red band on the wrist.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the band tight or loose?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose enough to slide a finger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he mind wearing it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He forgets, so we look twice.
dialogue.zh: 他會忘，所以我們多看兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a sign on the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə saɪn ɑn ðə dɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a red star at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə rɛd stɑr æt ðə tɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a note at the foot of the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə noʊt æt ðə fʊt ʌv ðə bɛd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same words, so all can read.
dialogue.zh: 字句一樣，讓人人都看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we write it in the book too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi raɪt ɪt ɪn ðə bʊk tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three places, never only one.
dialogue.zh: 要寫三個地方，絕不只一處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the board at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə bɔrd æt ðə dɛsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left wall, under the round clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it show short names only?
dialogue.zh: 上面只寫短短的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed number and one food.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can a patient forget his allergy?
dialogue.zh: 病人會忘記自己的過敏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All the time, age does that.
dialogue.zh: 常常這樣，年紀會讓人忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the auntie with nuts?
dialogue.zh: 那位堅果過敏的阿姨呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She hides cookies sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find one last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, under her pillow, sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she eat the whole thing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only half a small bite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was her face checked after?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every hour, all was calm.
dialogue.zh: 每小時都看，一切都平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a name on the list is wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ə neɪm ɑn ðə lɪst ɪz rɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果名單上有個名字是錯的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the family, then write the date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑsk ðə ˈfæməli, ðɛn raɪt ðə deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 去問家屬，然後標上日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some families bring herb water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask about every bottle.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，每個瓶子都要問清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can herb tea hide a nut?
dialogue.zh: 草茶裡可能藏著堅果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can, so keep the cup here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn, soʊ kip ðə kʌp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 有可能，杯子先留在我這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we ask about skin creams?
dialogue.zh: 皮膚用的藥膏也要問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, white tubes from the store.
dialogue.zh: 要，那種商店買的軟管藥膏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stop a cream from them?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɑp ə krim frʌm ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 我能先不讓他們擦那個藥膏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it and tell the doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kip ɪt ænd tɛl ðə ˈdɑktər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，收起來再告訴醫生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if his skin turns red?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, call, and stay calm.
dialogue.zh: 先停藥，打電話，而且要穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast must I call?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Within one minute, no waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there an emergency cart near?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the red one by the stair.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə rɛd wʌn baɪ ðə stɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does that cart hold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medicine, air tubes, and tape.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I open it myself?
dialogue.zh: 我要自己打開那輛車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call first, then open together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who signs after giving medicine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sign, right in the book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I cannot read the name?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ kænˈɑt rid ðə neɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我讀不清那個名字呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask a second nurse, always.
dialogue.zh: 一定要請第二位護理師看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That rule I will keep well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, harm comes from hurry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did anything happen tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚過敏那邊出了事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, and that is my best news.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ænd ðæt ɪz maɪ bɛst nuz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這就是我最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this list is all clear now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs lɪst ɪz ɔl klɪr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以這張名單現在都清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear, and my eyes are heavy.
dialogue.zh: 都清楚了，我的眼睛好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go rest, I will guard the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /goʊ rɛst, aɪ wɪl gɑrd ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 去休息吧，名單我會守好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, sign the page first.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，請先在那一頁簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should my name go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Below my line, in that thin box.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈloʊ maɪ laɪn, ɪn ðæt θɪn bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 在我那行下面，那個細格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I write the time beside it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ raɪt ðə taɪm bɪˈsaɪd ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, seven oh five, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven oh five, and my full name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən oʊ faɪv, ænd maɪ fʊl neɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that closes my night.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這樣我的夜就結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hand is shaking a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten hours, the pen feels heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add one note for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æd wʌn noʊt fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我能替你加一行備註嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, about his cold hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, I wrote it slow and clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, aɪ roʊt ɪt sloʊ ænd klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，我寫得又慢又清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a good helper, Ben.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben is fine, my mother calls me Bear.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛn ɪz faɪn, maɪ ˈmʌðər kɔlz mi bɛr./
dialogue.zh: 班很好，我媽從小叫我小熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bear is a strong name here.
dialogue.zh: 小熊在這裡是個有力的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, your card is in the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, jʊr kɑrd ɪz ɪn ðə məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 你的卡插進打卡機了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the slot is on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, ðə slɑt ɪz ɑn ðə wɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to punch my card, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu pʌntʃ maɪ kɑrd, tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我也要打我自己的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, at eight, when yours starts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine takes a small blue card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin teɪks ə smɔl blu kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 這台機器吃藍色的小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours is green, mine is old.
dialogue.zh: 你的是綠色的，我那張舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It stamps the hour on the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stæmps ði ˈaʊər ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, seven oh six today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That beep, is it normal?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normal, it always sings at seven.
dialogue.zh: 正常，它七點一定叫一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more copy for the file.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it in the tray on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɪn ðə treɪ ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 放到架子上那個盤子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shift ended at seven, right?
dialogue.zh: 你的班七點就下班了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven, but I am seven over.
dialogue.zh: 七點，但我多待了七分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they pay the extra hour?
dialogue.zh: 多出來的那小時會給錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The head nurse writes it herself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is she now this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the back office, with tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I say hello to her first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ seɪ hɛˈloʊ tu hɜr fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我要先去跟她打個招呼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later, she signs the book at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər, ʃi saɪnz ðə bʊk æt naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，她九點會簽本子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, then here is my hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake, and sorry for the cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your locker is the tall one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second from the end, on top.
dialogue.zh: 從最裡面數第二個，上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your coat smells like weak coffee.
dialogue.zh: 你的外套有淡淡的咖啡味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sat on the desk all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sæt ɑn ðə dɛsk ɔl naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want your blanket back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it for the next night.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, kip ɪt fər ðə nɛkst naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grey one from the couch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I never washed it either.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You left your cup by the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɛft jʊr kʌp baɪ ðə foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你的杯子還留在電話邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will drink it at home, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl drɪŋk ɪt æt hoʊm, ˈmeɪbi./
dialogue.zh: 也許我回家再喝那一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wash it, sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are too good to me, Ben.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr tu gʊd tu mi, bɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who takes the floor today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You, with Lia from two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lia, the fast one with glasses?
dialogue.zh: 戴眼鏡、動作快的莉雅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is kind, ask her anything.
dialogue.zh: 她很和氣，什麼都可以問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you two work many nights?
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個搭過很多次夜班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty, maybe a few more.
dialogue.zh: 四十次，說不定還多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she know about the drip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will tell her, that is you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl tɛl hɜr, ðæt ɪz ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你得告訴她，現在是你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will tell her twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it in red, she likes red.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɪn rɛd, ʃi laɪks rɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bag is by the chair, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr bæɡ ɪz baɪ ðə tʃɛr, si?/
dialogue.zh: 你的包就在椅子邊，看到沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I nearly left my keys.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your phone died, did it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Black since five, no call to Mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk sɪns faɪv, noʊ kɔl tu mɑm./
dialogue.zh: 五點就黑屏，還沒打給我媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use our charger, the white cord.
dialogue.zh: 用我們的充電線，白色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No time, she will wait, she knows.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ taɪm, ʃi wɪl weɪt, ʃi noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 來不及了，她會等我，她知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She worries, your mother.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One night in ten, I call too late.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn naɪt ɪn tɛn, aɪ kɔl tu leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十個晚上就有一次，我打太晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call from the gate, it works there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl frʌm ðə geɪt, ɪt wɜrks ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 到了大門再打，那邊有訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good tip, keep it in mind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shoes, the soft ones, keep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really mean I can have them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈrɪli min aɪ kæn hæv ðɛm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They fit me at home, maybe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they are mine, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go before the ward wakes up.
dialogue.zh: 趁病房還沒全醒，快走吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to see bed three once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tu si bɛd θri wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我想再去三號床看一眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His curtain is open, go in.
dialogue.zh: 他的簾子是開的，進去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is awake, and waving at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz əˈweɪk, ænd ˈweɪvɪŋ æt mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you say to him now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju seɪ tu hɪm naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, old man, I am off.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl, oʊld mæn, aɪ æm ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 好好睡吧老先生，我下班了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said the same to me in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd ðə seɪm tu mi ɪn dʒun./
dialogue.zh: 六月他也對我說過一樣的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is a good man, keep him safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ə gʊd mæn, kip hɪm seɪf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, and you rest your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl, ænd ju rɛst jʊr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我會的，你去讓眼睛休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eyes are closed already, see?
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛早就想閉上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun came out, look up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn keɪm aʊt, lʊk ʌp ðɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After all that rain, how nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sky looks like fresh milk.
dialogue.zh: 天空白得像剛倒的牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have missed the morning sky.
dialogue.zh: 我好久沒看到清晨的天了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guard is waving from below.
dialogue.zh: 保全在樓下朝我們揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He always waves, what a man.
dialogue.zh: 他每次都會揮手，真好的一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus is early today, listen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear it, the seven bus, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hiər ɪt, ðə ˈsɛvən bʌs, jɛs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your seat is the last one, empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr sit ɪz ðə læst wʌn, ˈɛmpli./
dialogue.zh: 你的座位是最後面那個，空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one by the window, my luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ, maɪ lʌk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the folder for the doctor.
dialogue.zh: 等等，給醫生的那個夾子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the desk, take it at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə dɛsk, teɪk ɪt æt naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, and your pen, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, it writes well for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt, ɪt raɪts wɛl fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door is open, off you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr ɪz ˈopoʊn, ɔf ju goʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is yours now, every line.
dialogue.zh: 現在這裡每一行都是你的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You earned your sleep, every bit.
dialogue.zh: 那一覺是你應得的，一點不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will sleep while the sun is high.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl slip waɪl ðə sʌn ɪz haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我要趁太陽高掛時大睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the ward is waking up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I hear the first good morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ hiər ðə fɜrst gʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我聽到第一聲早安了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Miss Kao is mopping the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say good morning to her, she is new.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ gʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ tu hɜr, ʃi ɪz nu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Miss Kao, nice floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She smiles, you did it right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The food cart man is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He brings warm rice at seven.
dialogue.zh: 他七點送來熱騰騰的稀飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning to him, too, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He knows my coffee cup well.
dialogue.zh: 他很清楚我的咖啡杯要多大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the man with the tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə mæn wɪð ðə treɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our Jim, he sings while he works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊr dʒɪm, hi sɪŋz waɪl hi wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 我們的老吉，邊工作邊唱歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jim hums the morning news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and no one asks him to.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd noʊ wʌn ɑsks hɪm tu./
dialogue.zh: 對，而且沒人請他這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guard is up, look at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə gɑrd ɪz ʌp, lʊk æt ðə geɪt./
dialogue.zh: 保全起來了，看大門那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waves first, every single day.
dialogue.zh: 他一定先揮手，天天如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lia is here, the fast one.
dialogue.zh: 莉雅到了，那個動作快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now say it, good morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Lia, I am Ben.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben, that is a warm hello.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See how calm they both look.
dialogue.zh: 你看她們兩個都好從容。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good hello does that work.
dialogue.zh: 一聲好的早安就有這效力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lia asks how the night went.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her: quiet, with two small calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr: ˈkwaɪət, wɪð tu smɔl kɔlz./
dialogue.zh: 就跟她說：安靜，只有兩通小電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will say calm, and one new drip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪ kɑm, ænd wʌn nu drɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我會說平穩，還換了一個吊瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the allergy page is red.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ði əˈlɜrdʒi peɪdʒ ɪz rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 對，還要提那張紅的過敏頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is writing it down fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give her the page number, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page nine, and the last column.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she nods like she knows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she always come at seven?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, with clean hands and tea.
dialogue.zh: 每次都是，手很乾淨，還帶茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
