dialogue.text: The ward door, can you hear that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔrd dɔr, kæn ju hiər ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 病房那扇門，你聽到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first curtain is going back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Auntie May says good morning first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is the sun of this ward.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ðə sʌn ʌv ðɪs wɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 她就是這個病房的太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I answer a sweet old lady?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ˈænsər ə swit oʊld ˈleɪdi?/
dialogue.zh: 我該怎麼回一位和藹的老太太？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it back, loud and slow.
dialogue.zh: 把早安大聲慢慢回給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I said it, and she laughed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course you did, you are kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ju dɪd, ju ɑr kaɪnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed two is still grumpy today.
dialogue.zh: 二號床今天還在鬧脾氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is grumpy till his tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pull his blind up?
dialogue.zh: 我要把他的窗簾拉開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, light makes him a nicer man.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, laɪt meɪks hɪm ə ˈnaɪsər mæn./
dialogue.zh: 要，光一到，他就變好相處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is on his blanket now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn ɪz ɑn hɪz ˈblæŋkɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 太陽已經照在他毯子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him ten minutes, then talk.
dialogue.zh: 給他十分鐘，再跟他講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed three is watching the birds.
dialogue.zh: 三號床在看窗外的小鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves those small brown guests.
dialogue.zh: 他愛那些褐色的小客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sparrow sat on the rail.
dialogue.zh: 有一隻麻雀停在床欄上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not scare it, he will tell me.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt skɛr ɪt, hi wɪl tɛl mi./
dialogue.zh: 別嚇牠，他今晚會告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His son will hear about the bird.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz sʌn wɪl hiər əˈbaʊt ðə bɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 他兒子會聽到這隻鳥的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tonight, at half past seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the night nurse now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is still in the hall, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz stɪl ɪn ðə hɔl, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想她還在走廊上沒走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nina, are you still standing here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wanted one last look around.
dialogue.zh: 我想再最後看一眼這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more good morning, then go.
dialogue.zh: 再說一次早安，然後就回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good morning, ward, I did my best.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ, wɔrd, aɪ dɪd maɪ bɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the sweetest thing today.
dialogue.zh: 這是最動人的一句話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I say it every morning, almost.
dialogue.zh: 我幾乎每個早晨都這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smell of rice fills the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɛl ʌv raɪs fɪlz ðə hɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the best smell after night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə bɛst smɛl ˈæftər naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 守完夜之後這是最好聞的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who needs help with a spoon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two: the auntie and the new man.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu, ði ˈænti ænd ði nu mæn./
dialogue.zh: 兩位：那位阿姨和新老先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sit with them, slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will eat more with a friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl it mɔr wɪð ə frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 有人陪他們會多吃一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is your tea, from the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz jʊr ti, frʌm ðə ˈkɪtʃən./
dialogue.zh: 這杯茶是廚房請妳喝的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, you got it hot, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ju gɑt ɪt hɑt, θæŋk ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doctor Hsu is coming down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand by the cart, he likes that.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd baɪ ðə kɑrt, hi laɪks ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 站在推車旁，他喜歡那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said good morning and kept walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd gʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ ænd kɛpt ˈwɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 他丟下早安就繼續往前走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is his morning style, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walking teacher is at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈtitʃər ɪz æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 教走路的老師到門口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her name is Ann, she is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr neɪm ɪz æn, ʃi ɪz laʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud is good for old legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She makes them laugh, then they move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi meɪks ðɛm læf, ðɛn ðeɪ muv./
dialogue.zh: 她先讓他們笑，笑完就走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The new man in bed eight?
dialogue.zh: 那八號床的新老先生呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is awake, and wants water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I gave it, in the small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ geɪv ɪt, ɪn ðə smɔl kʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, you already know this ward.
dialogue.zh: 你看，你已經懂這個病房了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing I still must learn.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dim switch, and the red page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɪm swɪtʃ, ænd ðə rɛd peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 調光的開關，還有那張紅單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know both, I wrote them down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ boʊθ, aɪ roʊt ðɛm daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣我都會了，我寫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you are ready, truly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What will you do on the bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt wɪl ju du ɑn ðə bʌs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep sitting up, with my mouth open.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈsɪtɪŋ ʌp, wɪð maɪ maʊθ ˈopoʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not, that is too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du nɑt, ðæt ɪz tu mʌtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hide behind my bag.
dialogue.zh: 我會把臉躲在包包後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bus is here, I hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr bʌs ɪz hɪr, aɪ hiər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你的公車來了，我聽見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that hiss is my alarm now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt hɪs ɪz maɪ əˈlɑrm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，那聲放氣就是我的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me if you think of something.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl mi ɪf ju θɪŋk ʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 如果你想起什麼，就打給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ring the office, once only.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rɪŋ ði ˈɔfɪs, wʌns ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 我只打給護理站，一次而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once is enough, then sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my plan, all day.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我的計畫，睡整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ward is loud now, look.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud means all is going well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last one: your name in the book.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst wʌn: jʊr neɪm ɪn ðə bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事：妳的名字在本子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it is, beside yours, see?
dialogue.zh: 就在那裡，挨著你的，看見沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, and goodbye, friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, my dear day man.
